title: GPS-PELL: a sharper exact coefficient and pure-exponential envelopes

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the single GPS-PELL algorithm (exactly the GPS-BLOCK configuration reproduced in proof.md, including its four hard cutoffs) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>3/4 from independent ideal source copies. On EVERY execution branch, including every retry, failed attempt, discard and abort, its total charged sequential work T(N,s) is O(2^(c sqrt(n log2 n))), with . The uniform bit-length envelope is B(n)=2^(c sqrt(n log2 n)) for n>=2, with n=1 handled by the explicit finite branch. Section 9.5 proves the exact coefficient and absorption of all polynomial work factors using the auxiliary c1 strictly between 1/sqrt(2) and c, for all n>=2^(2^4096); the finitely many smaller bit lengths contribute only an absolute outside constant. The exact growth index is 1/2. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. This bound holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the zero-tolerance claim for this same single algorithm/configuration.

For every integer N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the single GPS-PELL algorithm and complete parameter rule of proof.md (width profile, signed-leaf multibit odd decoder, root-frequency guard, Grover pair search, acquisition cutoff Qcap and weighted-attempt cutoff Wcap and capped verified-extraction fallback Cf) recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 > 3/4 from independent ideal source copies. On EVERY execution branch, including all retries, discarded copies, failed attempts and aborts, its peak allocated classical bits obey S_C(N,s) = O(n^2). The uniform bit-length envelope is B_C(n) = n^2 for n >= 2, with the explicit finite branch covering all smaller cases. Its exact growth index is 0. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N, s and outcomes, and this bound holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the zero-tolerance claim for this same algorithm/configuration.

For every integer N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the single GPS-PELL algorithm and complete parameter rule of proof.md (width profile, signed-leaf multibit odd decoder, root-frequency guard, Grover pair search, acquisition cutoff Qcap and weighted-attempt cutoff Wcap and capped verified-extraction fallback Cf) recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 > 3/4 from independent ideal source copies. On EVERY execution branch, including all retries, discarded copies, failed attempts and aborts, its peak allocated qubits obey S_Q(N,s) = O(n). The uniform bit-length envelope is B_Q(n) = n for n >= 2, with the explicit finite branch covering all smaller cases. Its exact growth index is 0. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N, s and outcomes, and this bound holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the zero-tolerance claim for this same algorithm/configuration.

For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the single GPS-PELL algorithm (exactly the GPS-BLOCK configuration reproduced in proof.md, including its four hard cutoffs) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>3/4 from independent ideal source copies. On EVERY execution branch, including every retry, failed attempt, discard and abort, its total number Q(N,s) of fresh DCP source copies acquired, counting every rejected, discarded and failed copy is O(2^(c sqrt(n log2 n))), with . The uniform bit-length envelope is B(n)=2^(c sqrt(n log2 n)) for n>=2, with n=1 handled by the explicit finite branch. Section 9.5 proves the exact coefficient and absorption of all polynomial work factors using the auxiliary c1 strictly between 1/sqrt(2) and c, for all n>=2^(2^4096); the finitely many smaller bit lengths contribute only an absolute outside constant. The exact growth index is 1/2. All outside constants are absolute and independent of N,s and outcomes. This bound holds jointly with the other three resource bounds and the zero-tolerance claim for this same single algorithm/configuration.

For the same GPS-PELL algorithm and complete parameter rule in proof.md, the proved malformed-sample fractional guarantee is epsilon(n)=0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, unconditional full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8 > 3/4 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted, and this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
